description: Implementation of SensorPrivacyManager class managing sensor privacy features, including service connection, listener management, and privacy status queries.

classes.name: SensorPrivacyManager
classes.description: Manages sensor privacy settings and listeners, interfacing with the hardware service.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the sensor privacy service, waiting if necessary until it is available.

methods.name: supportsSensorToggle
methods.description: Checks if a specific sensor toggle is supported.

methods.name: addSensorPrivacyListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for sensor privacy events.

methods.name: addToggleSensorPrivacyListener
methods.description: Adds a toggle sensor privacy listener, returning status.

methods.name: removeToggleSensorPrivacyListener
methods.description: Removes a toggle sensor privacy listener.

methods.name: isSensorPrivacyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if sensor privacy is enabled.

methods.name: isToggleSensorPrivacyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if toggle sensor privacy is enabled for a sensor.

methods.name: isToggleSensorPrivacyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if toggle sensor privacy is enabled for a specific toggle type and sensor.

methods.name: isToggleSensorPrivacyEnabled
methods.description: Checks toggle sensor privacy status with output parameter.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Links a death recipient to the service.

methods.name: unlinkToDeath
methods.description: Unlinks a death recipient from the service.
